Subject: Vendor activation packet — initial ask

Hi Amy,

Thanks for confirming Peregrine is ready to move forward — excited to get you activated. To complete our procurement checklist and route the PO, could you please send the following items by EOD Thursday: 

1) Completed PO template (we can accept vendor or customer PO)
2) Point of contact for billing and an email for invoice routing
3) Signed DPA or confirmation you're able to sign ours (I can send a draft)
4) SOC 2 report link (or attest letter) and the current subprocessor list

If it's helpful, Marissa (vendor ops) will handle the upload to our vendor portal and Karthik (procurement) will outline PO routing once we have the template. Ben, please chime in if you need anything else on security.

Next steps after we receive the docs: we provision a vendor record, route the PO to finance, and schedule a short activation call to confirm integration details.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
